recipes.name: Overnight Blueberry Oats
recipes.timeNote: plus a night in the fridge
recipes.desc: Make it at 10pm, grab it at 7am. Creamy, cold and properly filling.
steps: In a jar, stir the oats, chia seeds, yogurt and milk until no dry oats are left.
Fold in half the blueberries, then top with the rest and the honey.
Seal and refrigerate for at least 6 hours. Eat cold, or loosen with a splash of milk.
recipes.tip: Make three jars on Sunday; they keep for 3 days.

recipes.name: Greek Chickpea Salad
recipes.desc: No cooking at all. Crunchy, salty, lemony and it travels well.
steps: Dice the cucumber, halve the tomatoes and slice the onion thinly.
Toss everything except the feta with the oil, lemon juice, oregano, salt and pepper.
Crumble the feta over the top.
recipes.tip: Packing it for tomorrow? Keep the feta separate until you eat.

recipes.name: Sheet-Pan Salmon & Sweet Potato
recipes.desc: One tray, one wash-up. Omega-3s, fibre and almost no effort.
steps: Heat the oven to 220°C. Cube the sweet potato, toss with half the oil, paprika and salt, and roast for 12 minutes.
Toss the broccoli with the rest of the oil and the sliced garlic. Push the potatoes to the sides, add the broccoli, and lay the salmon in the middle. Season.
Roast 12 to 14 minutes until the salmon flakes. Squeeze lemon over everything.

recipes.name: Tuna Avocado Wrap
recipes.desc: Desk-lunch rescue. Nearly 40 g of protein from the cupboard.
steps: Mash the avocado with the yogurt, lemon and pepper.
Fold in the tuna.
Lay spinach on the tortilla, add the tuna mix, roll tightly and cut in half.

recipes.name: Weeknight Red Lentil Dal
recipes.desc: Cheap, cosy and freezes like a dream. Plant protein with serious fibre.
ing: 2 tsp curry powder, 1 tsp cumin, salt
steps: Soften the chopped onion in the oil for 4 minutes. Add garlic, ginger and spices and stir for 1 minute.
Add the rinsed lentils, tomatoes, coconut milk and 400 ml water. Simmer 18 minutes, stirring now and then, until thick.
Stir in the spinach until wilted. Season and serve.
recipes.tip: Freeze portions flat in bags. They reheat in 5 minutes.

recipes.name: Garlic Prawn Zoodles
recipes.desc: Pasta energy without the pasta. Light, garlicky and very high protein.
steps: Heat the oil over medium-high. Add garlic and chilli for 30 seconds, then the prawns, 2 minutes per side until pink. Lift them out.
Add the tomatoes and cook 2 minutes until they burst. Add the courgette and toss for 2 minutes only.
Return the prawns, season and finish with parmesan.
recipes.tip: Don't salt the courgette until the end, or it goes watery.

recipes.name: Sticky Tofu Edamame Bowl
recipes.desc: Crispy, salty-sweet tofu over brown rice. A takeaway you can feel good about.
steps: Cook the rice according to the pack.
Cube the tofu and pan-fry in the oil for 8 to 10 minutes until golden on all sides.
Mix the soy sauce and honey, pour over the tofu and let it bubble for 1 minute to glaze.
Boil the edamame for 3 minutes. Build bowls with rice, tofu, edamame, grated carrot and spring onion.
recipes.tip: Microwave rice pouches cut this to 15 minutes.

recipes.name: Chicken Burrito Bowls
recipes.desc: Four lunches in thirty minutes. The meal-prep classic for a reason.
steps: Cook the rice.
Slice the chicken, toss with spices, salt and half the oil, and pan-fry 6 to 7 minutes until cooked through.
In the same pan, cook the sliced peppers and onion in the rest of the oil for 5 minutes. Warm the beans and corn.
Divide everything between 4 boxes and squeeze lime over. Add avocado on the day you eat it.

recipes.name: Cottage Cheese Apple Crunch
recipes.desc: Tastes like apple pie, eats like a protein shake.
steps: Dice the apple.
Spoon the cottage cheese into a bowl, top with apple and roughly broken walnuts.
Drizzle with honey and dust with cinnamon.

recipes.name: Hidden-Veg Beef Pasta
recipes.desc: Family bolognese with extra veg nobody notices. Leftovers are lunch.
steps: Boil the pasta in salted water.
Meanwhile soften the onion and grated carrot in the oil for 5 minutes. Add the beef and brown for 5 minutes, breaking it up.
Add garlic, tomatoes and oregano and simmer 10 minutes. Stir in the spinach.
Toss with the drained pasta and top with parmesan.

recipes.name: Peanut Banana Smoothie
recipes.desc: Breakfast you drink on the way out. Thick, nutty and keeps you going.
steps: Put everything in a blender.
Blend 45 seconds until smooth. Add more milk if too thick.

recipes.name: Lemon Cod, Peas & Quinoa
recipes.desc: Clean, bright and very lean. The one for when you want to feel light.
steps: Rinse the quinoa and simmer in 240 ml water for 15 minutes, adding the peas for the last 3.
Season the cod and pan-fry in the oil 3 to 4 minutes per side.
Wilt the spinach and garlic in the pan juices for 1 minute.
Fluff the quinoa with lemon and herbs, and serve with the cod and greens.

recipes.name: Hummus & Egg Power Toast
recipes.desc: Jammy eggs on creamy hummus. The weekend brunch you can do on a Tuesday.
steps: Boil the eggs for 6½ minutes, cool in cold water and peel.
Toast the bread and spread with hummus.
Top with halved tomatoes, the halved eggs, chilli flakes, salt and pepper.

recipes.name: Tahini Chickpea Traybake
recipes.desc: Roasty, nutty, plant-based and mostly hands-off oven time.
steps: Heat the oven to 210°C. Cube the sweet potato, cut the onion into wedges and toss both with the chickpeas, oil, cumin and salt.
Roast 30 minutes, turning once.
Whisk the tahini with lemon and 2 to 3 tbsp water until pourable.
Toss the spinach through the hot tray to wilt and drizzle with the sauce.
